commits_data.title: Create epan_get_environment_prefix() for dissectors
commits_data.message:
Create epan_get_environment_prefix() for dissectors

To aid encapsulation, add epan_get_environment_prefix() that will cache the value of application_configuration_environment_prefix() so that dissectors don't have a dependency on an application.
